name: Westward Bound
intro: Westwatch Trading Post sits on the western headland - follow the west road past Hearthside Rise and up the cliffs. Dunmore pays well for Lanternwick goods. Every crate you sell there drops his price a little, so watch the demand.

steps.text: Deliver a trade pack to Dunmore Vell at Westwatch

outro: Lanternwick sunroot! The cooks will weep. If you mean to make a habit of this, old Bertram in the village builds carts - four crates at a time beats one on your back.
